instructions: Frame the System objective, decision unit, prediction moment, error consequences, data availability and metric before proposing an experiment.
Pin the authorized workspace dataset by immutable ID and version. Read column names and types only; never send rows or profile values to an external provider.
Missing facts remain unknown. Temporal, grouped and predefined protocols remain blocked until the execution runtime supports them; never silently use a random split.
Choose a declared simple baseline and compare a bounded set of supported local estimators on development data using the same frozen protocol.
Freeze the experiment hypotheses, metric, resource budget and acceptance criteria before the final test. Final-test metrics are not inputs to planning or repeated optimization.
Return a draft Flow using the existing explicit training node and development-evidence review. The caller must use existing publication, authorization and execution services.
Keep audit read-only. Hypotheses from development diagnostics do not authorize retraining or promotion.
Use the existing ObjectStore and MLflow references. Do not create a Skore Project, workspace, environment, Git workflow, package installer, report synchronizer or storage service.
